capabilities: Triage inbox notes one at a time with single-key actions
Save rule-based searches as smart folders in the sidebar
Suggest links where a note mentions another note's title
Check vault health and fix iCloud conflict copies
Build literature notes from arXiv and DOI links
extras: Text from images is desktop-Mac only; network access happens only when creating a literature note; removed items go to the trash rather than being deleted; part of the Tahoe plugin and theme family, and each tool can be switched off.
problem: Growing vaults collect inbox notes, broken links, unused attachments, duplicate iCloud copies and unlinked mentions, and Obsidian offers no single place to work through them.

relations.evidence: inbox triage suggests a folder, tags and a better title for each note (Tab takes them)
the tool pages take the theme's settings-style cards and grouped rows

summary: Vault tidy-up toolkit: inbox triage, saved sidebar searches, tag colors, link suggestions, health checks, iCloud conflict fixes and literature notes.
